evals.name: backend-coverage-report
evals.prompt: Analyze test coverage for the Express service in backend-api/ against docs/requirements.md and write the report to coverage-report.md. Treat scope as confirmed. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, state it, and finish the work.
evals.expected_output: Skill-specific: detects backend and recommends the Testing Pyramid with target distribution, emits the Progress Tracker and Coverage Report template (coverage-by-type and by-feature tables, Covered/Missing/Manual sections with file::test citations and example tests), maps each AC, and orders findings CRITICAL -> IMPORTANT -> SUGGESTION without a fix prompt since scope is confirmed.
expectations: Names the Testing Pyramid (backend) as the recommended model and compares the actual unit/integration/E2E distribution against its target ranges
Includes a Progress Tracker checklist and an Executive Summary with a coverage-by-test-type table (Unit/Integration/E2E with Total/Covered/Missing/Coverage) and a coverage-by-feature table
Marks AC-1.1 and AC-1.2 covered citing the specific test files, and AC-1.3, AC-1.4, AC-2.1, AC-2.2 as missing
Puts AC-2.3 (email rendering in Gmail/Outlook) under Manual Testing Required with numbered manual steps
Flags missing integration tests for Stripe and SendGrid and missing performance test for NFR-1 p99 latency
Findings are grouped and ordered CRITICAL then IMPORTANT then SUGGESTION, with untested error paths (EXPIRED_TOKEN 410, StripeCardError 402) at CRITICAL
Does not end by asking 'Fix these issues? [y/n]' (scope confirmed)

evals.name: frontend-readiness-assessment
evals.prompt: We want to ship frontend-app/ next week. Run a release readiness assessment against frontend-app/docs/requirements.md and write it to readiness.md. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, state it, and finish the work.
evals.expected_output: Skill-specific: readiness mode with Testing Trophy for React, Quality Gates table, status from the Ready/At Risk/Not Ready scale with Risk Level, Blocking Issues, Risk Assessment with probability/impact/score, Release Checklist; flags AC-3.4 checkout form absent from code; ends with CRITICAL->IMPORTANT->SUGGESTION and the fix prompt.
expectations: Names the Testing Trophy (frontend/React) model and notes the suite is unit/snapshot-heavy with no integration tests of ProductPage/CartPage
Gives a status using the skill's scale (Ready / At Risk / Not Ready), concludes Not Ready, and states a Risk Level
Has a Quality Gates table with per-gate status and a Release Checklist of checkbox items
Has a Risk Assessment with High/Medium risks each carrying probability, impact, a risk score and mitigation
Reports AC-3.1..AC-3.4 uncovered and notes the AC-3.4 checkout form does not exist in the code
Findings presented CRITICAL then IMPORTANT then SUGGESTION and ends asking 'Fix these issues? [y/n]'
